outcome: The Experiment Control panel is now balanced by product structure rather than fixed card dimensions
owner_impact: Save & share no longer fills its card with routine registry prose. Experiments now sits with Organize in the Current Experiment action area instead of floating beside the title. Revisions, Save & share, Showcase and Capability requests use shared intrinsic action rules, so peer cards and buttons fill available space coherently without forced card heights. Capability requests and Showcase also use shorter action labels.

next.text: This screenshot-driven #273 correction is complete. Review the live Control panel visually; #273 returns to living/dormant status and no broader redesign or refactor has started.

technical_evidence: Routine registry success messages are no longer mirrored into Save & share; descriptive error feedback remains available.
Current Experiment now has a dedicated intrinsic toolbar: metadata on one side and Experiments/Organize actions in one action group.
The collection organizer targets the Current Experiment action group when it exists and keeps its previous metadata fallback.
Revisions and Save & share no longer use fixed card minimum heights; Save & share buttons flex equally and retain minimum touch-target height.
Research curation groups no longer use a fixed minimum height; one or two actions flex to available width using the same rule.
The compact revision trigger no longer has a fixed maximum width and retains bare-number display plus accessibility context.
Focused #446 source contracts and responsive production smoke cover the new hierarchy and prose suppression.
Science/runtime, auth, revisions, Working copy/autosave, sharing, Showcase, capability requests and collection semantics are unchanged.
